package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
)

// scenario for rows_to_struct_allocation_per_row_without_reuse: New struct allocated for each row scan instead of reusing a scratch variable.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule293PositiveRecord struct {
	ID    int
	Name  string
	Email string
}

func scenario293Positive(db *sql.DB) ([]Rule293PositiveRecord, error) {
	rows, err := db.Query("SELECT id, name, email FROM users")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var results []Rule293PositiveRecord
	for rows.Next() {
		var item Rule293PositiveRecord
		rows.Scan(&item.ID, &item.Name, &item.Email)
		results = append(results, item)
	}
	return results, rows.Err()
}
